summary: No loader/copy-engine defect: manager.resync_all/manager.load force-copy every declared file unconditionally, ignoring installed_files and manifest version. Staleness is structural -- regeneration is deliberately pull-only with no automated re-trigger outside skill-orchestrate's narrow inter-cycle checkpoint. Reproduced live on ~/.dotfiles (26 core scripts missing, deploy-headless.sh/verify-deploy.sh absent from both disk and installed_files, ~3 weeks since last resync). Recommend stamping a per-extension source_git_head (sibling to the already-recorded source_dir field) and a cheap non-blocking WARN in command-gate-in.sh naming deploy-headless.sh as the remedy on mismatch.

artifacts.summary: Root cause + detection design for silently stale .claude/ deploy trees.

next_action_hint: Run /plan 18: implement source_git_head stamping in state.lua/init.lua (Lua write side) and a check-deploy-freshness.sh + command-gate-in.sh preflight WARN (bash read side). No copy-engine fix is needed -- Part 1 concluded there is no loader defect.
